sloka: अथातिकायः कुपितो दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणमुत्थितम्।आदाय निशितं बाणमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ६.७१.५० ।।
transliteration: athātikāyaḥ kupito dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇamutthitam।ādāya niśitaṁ bāṇamidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 6.71.50 ।।

translations.english: Seeing Atikaya, furious Lakshmana sprang up and took a sharp shaft and spoke as follows.
